props.caption: Geneva. The United States is set to skip a review that cannot proceed without its representatives.
Australia’s proposed rules would apply to frontier AI companies operating there.
A privileged House resolution starts a 48-hour procedural clock; no impeachment vote has occurred.

items.note: The Human Rights Council says the U.S. review cannot proceed without national representatives.
Australia announced proposed mandatory safety and security duties for frontier AI companies.
Massie introduced a privileged resolution with eight articles against Hegseth.
A crane fell into a furnace at the HABAŞ steel plant; 17 workers were killed.
Voters rejected Proposition 40, the proposed one-time 5% billionaire wealth tax.
